description: Sample instrumented JavaScript task origins and return available timing, busy percentage and freeze attribution. Coverage depends on installed hooks; unattributed work can remain. Requires @buoy-gg/js-top. On a free account it returns the totals only (busy %, freezes); the table of origins needs Buoy Pro. The call waits for the sample: arrange the interaction during that window using an available concurrent driver or a person, rather than starting it after this call returns. clearFirst resets tracked statistics before sampling. Use get_js_thread_origin_detail for a returned row key and measure_renders for component render diagnostics.

clearFirst.description: Reset tracked statistics before sampling. Hook coverage and attribution limits still apply.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

durationMs.description: How long to sample before reading the table. Default 3000; clamped to 250–30000.

name: get_js_thread_top
